run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token aligns to one or more frames
build_gtn_loss_function: build a custom PyTorch autograd function using GTN graphs for frame-level to token-level loss
compute_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs and scoring with forward_score
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for each batch example using gtn backward and parallel_for
